name: Toxiproxy
description: TCP proxy framework by Shopify for simulating network conditions (latency, bandwidth, connection drops) for chaos and resiliency testing.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present; GHCR: ghcr.io/shopify/toxiproxy; legacy Docker Hub for versions <= 2.1.4

eval_notes: Network fault injection proxy with 12k stars. REST API for programmatic toxic injection. Client libraries in 10+ languages. Ideal for testing agent resilience to network failures in evaluation scenarios. Integrates with CI/CD pipelines.
